title: Basic English — Course 1, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 15

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. Where will the session take place?
tasks.audioText: The electrical laboratory session starts at one o'clock in Lab 3. Before the lesson, check that your worksheet is complete and put your bag under the bench. The instructor will demonstrate how to connect the low-voltage training circuit. Do not connect the power supply until the instructor checks your circuit. At the end, switch off the supply and return all leads to the labelled box.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. When may students connect the power supply?
tasks.audioText: The electrical laboratory session starts at one o'clock in Lab 3. Before the lesson, check that your worksheet is complete and put your bag under the bench. The instructor will demonstrate how to connect the low-voltage training circuit. Do not connect the power supply until the instructor checks your circuit. At the end, switch off the supply and return all leads to the labelled box.
options: After the instructor checks the circuit

tasks.prompt: Reading 1. Read the text. Sam is learning about a simple electrical circuit. The instructor gives the group a battery, connecting leads and a small lamp. Sam follows the diagram and checks that each connection is secure. The lamp does not light, so he switches off the supply and checks the connections again. He finds that one lead is loose and fixes it before asking the instructor to check the circuit. Why does Sam check the connections again?
Reading 2. What does Sam do before checking the circuit?
Choose the correct instruction: '___ the power supply before changing a connection.'
Choose TWO safe actions in an electrical laboratory.
options: Change a connection while the supply is on.
Switch off the supply before changing connections.

tasks.prompt: Complete with one word: 'A wire used to connect components in a circuit is a connecting ___.'
You notice a damaged lead. What should you tell the instructor?
options: This lead is damaged. Should I replace it?

tasks.prompt: Put the circuit-checking steps in the correct order.
options: Ask the instructor to check the circuit
Follow the diagram to connect components
Switch off the supply before making changes
Check that the connections are secure
correctOrder: Ask the instructor to check the circuit
Follow the diagram to connect components
Switch off the supply before making changes
Check that the connections are secure

tasks.prompt: Write 60–80 words explaining how to work safely with a low-voltage training circuit. Include checking the diagram, switching off the supply and reporting damaged equipment.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: relevant content and completion of the task (0–2); clear organisation and sequence (0–2); understandable grammar and sentence structure (0–2); appropriate vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2). Minor errors are acceptable if meaning remains clear.
